rule.selection_uses_only: locked support texts, tokenization, native hash; no state values, drift, NLL, accuracy, or query row selection
rule.main_token_rule: Actual token byte offset overlaps UTF-8 bytes of any structural character span (positive overlap). Field-following spaces and newlines are structural. A token crossing structural/content character spans is included and separately attributed. No re-tokenization is used for span alignment.
rule.main_row_rule: Union of all 16 physical rows read at selected endpoint-token positions over all 35000 supports. No query, boundary, host, or writer dependence.
rule.language_value_rule: Language concrete value is not a structural span; its overlapping-token rows are a separate diagnostic set.
rule.strict_token_rule: All characters of endpoint token lie in structural spans. Saved separately, not the main mask.
rule.pure_ngram_rule: Every token in the native reset-aware 2/3-gram lies fully within structural spans; EOS padding counts as template.
rule.mixed_context_rule: Selected structural endpoint but at least one n-gram token is not fully structural. Includes character-boundary tokens and content-history crossings.
rule.collision_note: A physical row may belong to multiple categories or also be read by content; masks do not isolate a causal pure-format fraction.
rule.canonical_row_list_sha256_rule: SHA256 of UTF-8 compact JSON sorted integer list, no newline
